statusNote: Compared with Run 1: same elements in the same order and the same finished layout; the cycle is much slower (9.7 s vs 5.5 s), mostly from a long pink-brick press/hold (about 4 s) and a long blue-slope press (about 3 s).

elements.label: Idle before cycle
elements.observed: Pink brick, white plate and blue slope lie apart on the table. A hand rests still at the bottom right corner; no part moves.

elements.label: Reach and grasp pink 1×6 brick
elements.observed: One hand enters from the top right, closes on the pink brick on the table and lifts it.

elements.label: Place pink brick on plate
elements.observed: The hand carries the pink brick to the white plate and lowers it onto the plate, held lengthwise.

elements.label: Hold the base plate
elements.observed: Second hand enters from the bottom right and grips the plate edge; the plate stays near its table position while the other hand presses.
elements.flag: Hands hide whether the plate stays flat on the table

elements.label: Press pink brick down
elements.observed: Fingers of the upper hand stay on the pink brick and press along it; little changes in frame from about 2.0 s to 6.0 s. Blue slope remains on the table.
elements.flag: Long press, about 4 s; hands hide the brick, so any re-pressing cannot be confirmed

elements.label: Reach and grasp blue 2×2 slope
elements.observed: The lower hand leaves the plate, moves to the blue slope on the table and picks it up between fingertips.

elements.label: Carry blue slope
elements.observed: Blue slope carried back to the half-built piece in the lower hand.

elements.label: Position and orient blue slope
elements.observed: Slope held against the side of the pink brick near the plate's right side; fingers adjust it before it goes down.
elements.flag: Boundary with the press is hidden by the fingers

elements.label: Press blue slope down
elements.observed: Both hands stay on the assembly with the blue slope beside the pink brick; mostly hidden. Long, nearly static stretch.
elements.flag: Long press, about 3 s; hands hide the pressing and any re-pressing

elements.label: Release and set down
elements.observed: Hands let go of the assembly and withdraw: one toward the top, the other to the bottom right. The assembly is left on the table.

elements.label: Idle after cycle
elements.observed: Finished assembly alone on the table; one hand rests still at the bottom right and a hand edge sits at the top edge.

processData: Count of presses and re-grips visible
Idle time before and after the cycle
Finished-state check against the baseline layout
limitations: Hands hide the pressing, so press duration and any re-pressing cannot be confirmed
Parts are small in frame, so exact stud rows are hard to confirm
Whether the plate is lifted or stays flat during the long press is not clear

source.note: Claude Code, frame by frame at 0.1 s steps

differences: Pink brick pressed and held by both hands for about 4.0 s (2.00-6.00 s); Run 1 presses for 1.4 s.
Blue slope stays untouched on the table until about 6.1 s; Run 1 picks it at 2.4 s right after the pink press.
Blue slope press lasts about 3.0 s (7.40-10.40 s); Run 1 presses for 1.0 s.
Cycle 9.7 s vs 5.5 s; parts start far apart and the video has about 1.0 s of idle before and 0.9 s after.

finalState.note: Pink 1×6 brick on the plate's second stud column; blue 2×2 slope next to it over the third and fourth columns, slope facing outward, one white column free, same as Run 1.
